questions.statement: Every abstract polytope of finite rank has a minimal regular polytopal cover, unique iff marked monodromy is a string C-group; covers may be infinite.
For finite rank-four actual polytopes with non-C monodromy, there are infinitely many finite minimal regular covers; this is not a theorem in every finite rank.
A local interval regular-cover family extends to global finite regular covers, with exact hypotheses in the separate interval theorem.
General finite minimal-cover multiplicity in all ranks remains unresolved in this closed corpus.
